answer: Trust-graph bottleneck analysis curtails Sybil attacks by bounding capacity across peer topologies. Whether surveying a canyon, appraising quartz, or trading saffron, agents certify counterparties along paths anchored to trusted seed nodes. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of securing scarce, non-collusive trust edges from honest peers. However, this design penalizes legitimate newcomers and risks entrenching early network incumbents.
